every_other_rule_holds: delta = count − 1 holds. Image level is impossible: the observed start must equal the planned start, and a planned start this large makes the planned start-advance and EOD sums overflow (overflow-8.3-*), and puts the replica beyond any device-reportable position.

mutation.inputs: observed start LBA 2^64 − 1, observed record count 3, delta 2

quotes: the observed footer LBA (`0x2F0`) MUST equal the observed start LBA (`0x2E0`) plus that delta
target: observed footer LBA = observed start LBA + delta
